lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Héctor, it's Yolanda. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the bedtime goal went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Actually, I had a question about fruit at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How are you doing, really?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hanging in there.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Tell me how the bedtime goal went this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Some days yes, some days no. Maybe 3.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What did you notice on the days it went well?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've always eaten late, that's how we do it at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So it's not that you don't care. It's that taking care of everybody keeps getting in the way.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. I just didn't feel like it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Being around for my family is why I'm doing this. My grandson thinks it's funny that I have a step counter.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've noticed it makes a difference.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm too tired for this right now.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You already did the hardest part, which is starting.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel so much better on Sunday when I don't overdo it. I don't want to end up like my dad.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can stick to two beers if I eat first. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. My daughter keeps reminding me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good for you for planning ahead.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it. It's just me and my husband now, so it's easier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the bedtime goal. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want your energy back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That took effort.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe keep it to 2 drinks on the weekend?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 6.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 6 and not a 3?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, if I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If taking care of everybody gets in the way again, what's your backup plan?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll ask my son to come with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: taking care of everybody made this week harder, you still got 3 days in, and your plan is to keep it to 2 drinks on the weekend. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Héctor, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

flags.reason: 'I don't really see the point' may signal hopelessness; coach moved to advice without exploring. Verify wellbeing today.
Participant said 'Hanging in there' after a 'how are you really' probe; not explored further, and fatigue and low mood cues went unaddressed.
Participant's fruit-at-night question was never answered or returned to.
Repeated the same water-between-drinks advice after participant resisted at line 35; no reflection of the resistance.
Third verbatim repeat of the same tip; advice is generic and not tied to participant's stated strategies.

score.summary: Coach used good complex reflections and affirmations, and Héctor set a concrete goal with a backup plan. However, the coach repeated the same water tip three times, skipped the fruit question, and did not explore the 'I don't really see the point' statement, which may signal hopelessness.
strengths: Line 16 and line 52: complex reflections captured caregiving barrier and ambivalence well.
Line 44: open question elicited Héctor's own successful strategies.
Line 64: planned for barriers with a backup plan (son).
coaching_tips: Line 21: after 'I don't really see the point,' pause and ask open questions about meaning and mood before offering advice; screen for hopelessness.
Lines 34 and 42: do not repeat the same tip; reflect the resistance from line 35 and ask permission before any new suggestion.
Line 4: return to the fruit question early or schedule it, so the participant's agenda is honored.
Line 6: when a participant says 'hanging in there,' explore it with an open question rather than moving on.
Line 69: confirm the next call time with the participant, since the next contact was not set.
